This confirms all two-arg call sites pass `true` literally (excluding the function definition itself). Full breakdown:

**17 call sites** across **7 files** still pass the legacy second argument:

| File | Count |
|---|---|
| **`src\reports\quarterly.js`** | **5** ← most |
| `src\admin\exports.js` | 3 |
| `src\billing\invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src\checkout\cart.js` | 2 |
| `src\reports\monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src\checkout\receipt.js` | 1 |
| `src\billing\statement.js` | 1 |

`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with 5 calls (lines 16, 37, 58, 83, 104) all passing `true`. The remaining files (`refunds.js`, `dashboard.js`, `ledger.js`) use only the single-argument form already.
